description: The most recent receipts in the Vouchwell log: what was called, when, and whether the policy allowed, refused or escalated it. Filters narrow it to refusals, calls monitor mode would have blocked, calls that never finished, a tool, or a session.

denied.description: Only calls the policy refused or escalated.

tail.description: How many of the latest matching receipts to return (default 20).

target.description: Only tools whose name contains this text.

unfinished.description: Only calls that were authorised and sent but never reported a result.

would_block.description: Only calls monitor mode let through that the policy would have blocked.

name: log_entries
title: Recent receipts
